text: Hi, confirming prices for the heart t-light holders: your cost is £1.77 per unit on orders over 500. Retail is £2.95. End-of-line units can go to the outlet at 18p each. Weekly sales for the last two months were roughly: 690, 745, 810, 702, 866, 913, 788, 845.

Paper chains: sell $4.50, margin is 40%, so cost works out from that. Leftovers after Christmas are worthless. Stockouts really hurt, figure about $1 of goodwill per lost sale. We order monthly. Last 6 months: 210, 260, 240, 300, 890, 1450.

We buy the spotty jumbo bags at 1.17 and sell them at 1.95. Whatever is left at the end of the week goes in the clearance bin at about 20p. Last 8 weeks we sold: 812, 905, 877, 940, 865, 990, 1024, 958.

Mug restock, weekly. Price $12.00, cost $7.50, leftovers go back to the wholesaler at $2.00.

Selling at €25 with a 25% markup on cost. Unsold stock can be returned for €5 a piece. Monthly unit sales this year: 320, 355, 390, 410, 380, 365, 402, 445, 430, 470, 455, 490.
Fresh flower wraps: buy at 0.85, sell at 2.40. Anything unsold on Sunday goes in the bin, worth nothing. A missed sale costs us maybe 30 cents of goodwill. Last 6 weeks: 210, 185, 240, 260, 230, 275.
Quick one: the notebooks cost us $2.10 and we price them at $4.25. Clearance value is about fifty cents.
Last 12 weeks of unit sales for the red lunch bag, in order: 350, 372, 341, 389, 402, 377, 365, 390, 415, 388, 370, 396. No price changes planned.

restock question for the gliders: we pay £0.17 each (wholesale), shelf price £0.29. Leftover packs go to the discount basket at 3p. Weekly sales since September: 1012, 720, 48, 0, 1290, 860, 1430, 975. Stockouts are not a big deal for this line.
Candle line: retail $18.00 at a 60% margin. End-of-season stock clears at $4. Monthly sales: 95, 110, 88, 102, 130, 145, 160, 138.

Contract terms: unit cost 9.60, list price 15.00, returns credited at 2.50 per unit. Late delivery to the retailer triggers a penalty of about 1.20 per unit short. Weekly volumes: 480, 512, 495, 530, 505, 488, 520, 545, 510, 499.

We sell the trinket boxes at one twenty-five and buy them at seventy-five cents. Leftovers are worth maybe ten cents each at the market stall. Weekly sales hover in the high two hundreds; the last four weeks were 286, 301, 274, 312.

Selling price $8.50, cost $5.10, salvage $1.00. If we run out, each lost sale also costs us about $2 in goodwill. Weekly: 640, 702, 688, 730, 715, 760, 742, 705.
The silk fans sell for about 80p; we buy them at roughly 50p. Unsold fans have no real value afterwards. Weekly sales are usually between 150 and 200; recent weeks: 175, 162, 190, 158, 181, 170.

For the red spotty lunch bag only (ignore the pink one): price £1.65, cost £0.99, clearance £0.15. The pink bag sells for £1.95 but that is not what I am asking about. Weekly sales of the red bag: 350, 366, 342, 371, 359, 380, 348, 362.
We sell at $6.00 and buy at $3.60; leftovers are donated, so no salvage value. Sales have been steady all quarter but I do not have the weekly numbers in front of me.
We plan monthly. Price is $22, cost $13.20, and unsold units carry a salvage of $3.30. Monthly unit sales for the past half year: 540, 585, 560, 610, 575, 620.
